item.title: [data-breach] Eurail says December data breach impacts 300,000 individuals
item.description: Eurail B.V., a European travel operator that provides digital passes covering 33 national railways, says attackers stole the personal information of over 300,000 individuals in a December 2025 data breach. [...]

item.title: [data-breach] Eurail data breach impacted 308,777 people
item.description: Hackers breached Eurail in Dec 2025, stole names and passport data, and exposed over 300,000 travelers’ personal information. Threat actors breached Eurail in December 2025 and stole names and passport numbers from its network.
